CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION MINUTES

Kevin McGuan, Chair  Jacqueline Padilla-Perez, Commissioner
Mark Grisafe, Vice Chair  Marco Pizzo, Commissioner
Amy Bodek, Commissioner  Jocelynn Pryor, Commissioner
Tasha Hunter, Commissioner

  SPECIAL MEETING

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 6:10 PM, Vice Chair Grisafe called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Bodek, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo, Grisafe

Commissioners Absent: Hunter, Pryor, McGuan

Also present: Erin Weesner-McKinley, Principal Deputy City Attorney, Alison Spindler-Ruiz,
Planning Bureau Manager, Alejandro Sanchez-Lopez, Advanced Planning Officer,
Alejandro Plascencia, Planner, Felice Anaya, Clerk Typist, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist.

Vice Chair Grisafe spoke; and announced that Commissioner Hunter was excused from the meeting
and Chair McGuan and Commissioner Pryor were unexcused from the meeting.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Commissioner Bodek led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55694  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Bodek, seconded by Commissioner
  Pizzo, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bodek, Grisafe, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Hunter, Pryor, McGuan

  Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau Manager, Community Development, spoke;

  and provided the Director’s Report.

2.  24-55695  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Cultural Heritage Commission
  meeting of Tuesday, October 29, 2024.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Padilla-Perez, seconded by
  Commissioner Pizzo, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bodek, Grisafe, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Hunter, Pryor, McGuan

3.  24-55696  Recommendation to approve a Certificate of Appropriateness and adopt the
  proposed findings and conditions of approval thereto, to allow a 569 square foot
  rear addition, exterior remodel, and front façade modifications to a Craftsman
  single-family dwelling located at 1502 East 8th Street. The project site is located
  within the Hellman Craftsman Historic District, is a contributing structure, and is in
  the R-2-S zoning district. (District 1)

  A motion was made by Commissioner Bodek, seconded by Commissioner
  Pizzo, to approve recommendation, as amended, to [1] correct the east
  elevation to reflect the wider siding in the plans, [2] retain the sill height and
  opening size of the two north elevation windows, which will follow around to
  the sill height on the eastern elevation for the new windows in the existing
  portion of the home, [3] remove the planter at the front of the house, and [4]
  remove Condition No. 18. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  4  Bodek, Grisafe, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Hunter, Pryor, McGuan

  Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau Manager, Community Development, spoke.

  Liana Arechiga, Planner, Community Development, spoke; and provided a
  PowerPoint presentation.

  Commissioner Pizzo spoke.
